# 🔴 Acceptance 07 — Merge-Readiness Summary

> **Severity:** Merge-gate | **Priority:** Critical | **Prompt #:** 7 of 7

## Artifact Metadata

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Output | `MERGE_READY.md` at repo root + git tag + draft PR body |
| Depends on | Phase 9 prompts 01–06 |
| Blocks | Phase 10 (staging soak) |

## Single Goal

Produce a single human-readable `MERGE_READY.md` aggregating the 6 prior gate logs, tag the branch, and draft a PR description. Anyone can read this one file and decide go/no-go.

## What's Being Established

This is the artifact a reviewer (or you, the next morning) reads to decide "ship it to staging." Without this aggregation, evidence is scattered across logs/.

## Recommendation

### `MERGE_READY.md` template

```markdown
# db-refactor: Merge-Readiness Report

> Branch: `db-refactor/timescaledb-migration-mo-jsonb-at-all`
> Generated: <ISO timestamp>
> Sign-off: <your name>

## Summary

This branch completes the TimescaleDB-HA migration with full schema typing
(zero JSONB except 1 ADR-001 carve-out), CTI for automations (ADR-004),
and the hot/cold telemetry split (ADR-002). Ready for staging soak (Phase 10).

## Gate results

| # | Gate | Status | Evidence |
|--:|------|--------|----------|
| 1 | Go quality (build/vet/test/lint/vuln) | ✅ | logs/phase-9-01-*.log |
| 2 | Frontend quality (tsc/lint/audit/build/test) | ✅ | logs/phase-9-02-*.log |
| 3 | Fresh migration through 142 | ✅ | logs/phase-9-03-fresh-deploy-*.log |
| 4 | Zero-jsonb invariant (1 carve-out) | ✅ | logs/phase-9-04-jsonb-inventory.log |
| 5 | Carve-out documents ADR-001 | ✅ | logs/phase-9-05-jsonb-comment.log |
| 6 | All 7 hypertables have compression + retention | ✅ | logs/phase-9-06-policies.log |

## Schema artifacts

- 28 schema source files in `migrations/_baseline_source/`
- 1 baseline migration: `migrations/000142_baseline_typed.up.sql` (+ down)
- 9 ADRs in `.github/prompts/db-refactor/adrs/`
- 7 hypertables, 3 continuous aggregates

## Code artifacts

- Go: ~25 model files, ~20 repo files, new `internal/telemetry/` package
- Frontend: new `web/src/types/{signals,automations}.ts`, 15 hook files updated, ~XX page files touched

## Risk register

- **TS-HA image**: pinned to `pg17` major. Patch upgrades automatic via image tag policy.
- **Production data**: Phase 11 cutover is a fresh apply (additive, not squash). Existing prod schema untouched until Phase 11 gitops handoff.
- **Staging data loss**: Accepted per ADR-009.

## Next step

Phase 10 — staging soak (7-day metrics watch). Then Phase 11 — gitops handoff for production cutover.
```

### Git tag + PR draft

```powershell
cd D:\repos\teslasync

# Tag the branch state
git tag -a "db-refactor/merge-ready" -m "All Phase 9 gates green; ready for Phase 10 staging soak"
git push origin db-refactor/merge-ready

# Draft PR (gh CLI)
gh pr create --draft --base main `
  --title "db-refactor: TimescaleDB-HA migration with zero JSONB" `
  --body-file MERGE_READY.md
```

## Suggested Fix

1. Aggregate the 6 logs into MERGE_READY.md (above template)
2. Tag the branch
3. Open the draft PR
4. Commit MERGE_READY.md to the branch

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `MERGE_READY.md` exists at repo root
- [ ] All 6 gate evidence rows show ✅ with log path
- [ ] Tag `db-refactor/merge-ready` exists locally and pushed
- [ ] Draft PR opened (URL recorded in commit message)
- [ ] Committed

## Verification

```powershell
cd D:\repos\teslasync
Test-Path MERGE_READY.md
git tag --list "db-refactor/*"
gh pr list --draft --search "db-refactor"
```

## Out of Scope

- Don't merge the PR (Phase 10 + Phase 11 must complete first)
- Don't deploy to staging yet (Phase 10)
